title: Lightweight LLM attempt usage accounting

commands.name: affected adapter, workflow, conversation, and file-store tests
CodeAnalytics post snapshot and symbol queries

tests.name: Provider adapter, workflow lightweight path, conversation service, and file store

architectureChecks.name: CodeAnalytics pre/post
architectureChecks.evidence: snap-20260808153641-6d431e72 -> snap-20260808154230-6d431e72; no blocking errors, diagnostics, open questions, dependency cycles, or LlmUsage findings

architectureChecks.name: boundary ownership
architectureChecks.evidence: Abstractions owns immutable usage arithmetic/failure data; ProviderRuntime accumulates attempts; Workflows Runtime projects failure observations

architectureChecks.name: retry scope
architectureChecks.evidence: Only blank terminal responses retry; provider errors terminate immediately and caller cancellation remains unwrapped

architectureChecks.name: sanitization
architectureChecks.evidence: Typed public messages contain stable identifiers only; raw provider detail remains only in InnerException

bugs: The adapter created usage only for the terminal successful attempt, discarding usage from earlier blank attempts.
Typed invocation failures carried no known usage, forcing workflow failure observations to fabricate zero.

acceptance.criterion: Empty then success returns both attempts' usage.
Two empty attempts fail with both attempts' usage.
Empty then provider/deadline failure preserves known prior usage.
acceptance.evidence: Dedicated provider-failure and deadline tests both assert prior aggregate

acceptance.criterion: Negative counters fail at the owning boundary.
acceptance.evidence: LlmUsage negative theory and adapter invalid-report test

acceptance.criterion: Workflow failure analytics no longer fabricate zero when usage is known.

residualRisk: Usage is limited to Int32 counters by the existing provider/workflow contracts; totals that exceed representable bounds fail explicitly instead of saturating.
